item.title: Simplifying my Sway setup with DankMaterialShell
item.description: Over the years my Sway setup had grown into a pile of independently configured single-purpose tools: a bar, a launcher that also doubled as an emoji picker and power menu, a notification daemon, a lock screen plus idle daemon, a media-key/Bluetooth setup glued together with a few standalone helpers, and a separate screenshot tool. Each one worked, but each one was its own little island with its own config format and its own opinions about how to talk to the others.
